meaning:
κορέννυμι
(κόρος, surfeit), [in Symmachus.: Psa.22:27, Al, Psa.103:5 * ;]
to satisfy: pass., τροφῆς, Act.27:38; metaphorically, of spiritual things, 1Co.4:8.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: the men had eaten their fill

elsewhere.note: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you.
